resources.string: AI architectures and measurement across the five engines. Each experiment shows the run step by step.
One prompt on one engine with free configuration and its trace. The base of all the others.
Classifies the prompt, picks a local or cloud engine, escalates if the answer fails the check and filters personal data before it leaves.
Chunks and embeds documents on the device, retrieves by similarity and answers with citations. Compares with and without retrieval.
A think, act, observe loop with a calculator, clock, notes and more. Measures which engines can sustain it.
One engine plans, another writes and a critic reviews until it accepts. Each role can use a different engine.
An engine scores answers with a rubric or pits them against each other in pairs. Measures how far the judge can be trusted.
Self-consistency (N samples and a vote) and five ways of asking the same thing, with accuracy, tokens and time per engine.
Tasks with automatic scoring on every engine: ranking, heatmap, latencies and determinism.
How much the time to first token grows as the prompt gets longer, per engine.
Generates non-stop for minutes and shows whether the phone heats up and speed drops.
